checks.text: Quick Look. Space on a screenshot or a film opens Quick Look, as in Finder; Markup lets you circle what's wrong and attach it as the note.
Drag and drop. Drag a card into a terminal or a chat to paste its id and question; drop a screenshot on a card to attach it to your note.
Swipes on the list. Two fingers right takes my pick, left means later, as in Mail.
A real ⌘Z. Undo an answer from the Edit menu, not just with U.
Every key in the menus. A Review menu lists J/K, 1–9, L and S, so Help ▸ Search finds them, and a key you forget is one menu away.
Window tabs. ⌘T puts several projects' Review in one window's tabs.
Inbox zero gets a moment. A short sound and an empty screen that reads as done, like Things' checkmark sound.
The Dock badge carries the same count as the menu bar, so you see it in ⌘Tab.
A Services item, "Ask the agent about this", turns selected text in any app into a note for the project's agent.

options.label: Quick Look and Markup
options.act: QLPreviewPanel on media; Markup result attaches to note

options.label: Keys in the menus, plus a real ⌘Z
options.act: Review menu with every key; answers in the undo stack

options.label: Swipes, tabs, the inbox-zero sound, the Dock badge, Services

why: None of these is a feature you'd sell, but together they make it feel like a Mac app rather than a web page in a frame. That's the reason for the Mail model in Look closer.
